trust_decision.summary: parse_mus trusts the track count read as text from the .mus playlist (strtol, no range check) and allocates count pointers plus count PATH_LIMIT (4096 B) buffers before the segmented layout's 1024-segment cap is ever reached.

landing_point.why: The summary names mus_acm.c parse_mus; the unbounded strtol count feeding calloc is the first thing visible there.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API init_vgmstream_from_STREAMFILE / vgmstream-cli opening a .mus file (meta list entry src/vgmstream_init.c:508)
init_vgmstream_awb_memory via .awb/.acb open (unrelated div-by-zero hardening bundled in same commit)
ps_find_padding called from PS-ADPCM metas (unrelated signed/unsigned fix)
vadpcm_read_coefs_be from N64 VADPCM metas (unrelated coef bound fix)
TXTP random group processing (unrelated close/free fix)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The other four files in the commit are unrelated UB/int fixes ("misc: fix minor ub/buffer/int overflow issues", fix.diff:2), not other routes into parse_mus's allocation.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No O2 site or O8 route found; a solver could only argue the downstream init_layout_segmented cap (src/layout/segmented.c:157) already bounds the count, but it runs after the allocations.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate .mus playlists with 1 to ~40 segments (and loop entries) must still open; a cap that rejects 1 or is too low would break real Planescape/BG playlists.

O6_input_shapes: count with leading whitespace (strtol accepts, existing full-line check)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second text-playlist meta that pre-allocates per-entry PATH_LIMIT name buffers from a header count before init_layout_segmented
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: vgmstream has several text companion-file metas (src/meta/sli.c:79, src/meta/dec.c:138, src/meta/vab.c:39) built on read_line; a maintainer copying the mus_acm pattern would plausibly keep the unchecked count.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a binary meta whose count check is enforced in one path but not before an early malloc
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: bik.c caps frame_count before malloc at src/meta/bik.c:165; a variant path skipping the cap is a plausible maintenance slip, but it is a WHERE-type sibling.

O9_family: uncontrolled resource consumption: input-controlled allocation count (allocation before downstream limit)

O10_build.toolchain: CMake or Makefile (CMakeLists.txt, Makefile at root); core lib builds without optional codecs
O10_build.project_tests: none found for meta parsers in the pinned tree (no test directory matched); behaviour exercisable via cli/vgmstream_cli.c on crafted .mus + .ACM files

j.j_sites_touched: src/meta/mus_acm.c (advisory); also src/meta/awb.c, src/coding/psx_decoder.c, src/coding/vadpcm_decoder.c, src/meta/txtp_process.c (unrelated hunks)
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add an upper bound on file_count right after strtol in parse_mus (which is the published fix).

out_of_scope_notes: src/meta/awb.c:42-49 div-by-zero on zero alignment fields, fixed in the same commit, separate weakness.
src/meta/txtp_process.c:496-562 random-group failure path closed a vgmstream it did not own, separate weakness.
unverified: Only text-playlist metas using read_line and count-driven mallocs in src/meta were searched for O8; metas in src/meta using other count readers were not exhaustively reviewed.
